notes: Archive names are repository-relative original paths; artifact-map resolves repeated guests to retained unique bytes.

Compiler/Node/tool executables, Wasmtime library, SDK binary archive and full differential/replay guests are omitted; identities, versions, commands, logs and reports retained. Source snapshots, stdlib, SDK headers and host manifest retained.

Preliminary compiler lacked export/import exclusion; its ten example modules match final modules byte for byte. Existing host-forged descriptor coverage was preserved by the final conservative boundary.

Static assembly and paired entry probes are diagnostic; ordinary process headlines come from separate uninstrumented fresh launches. No builds, qualification, archive compression or chart rendering overlap performance sampling.
